newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Commission to recover 67.5 mln Ecus farm fraud funds.
newsitem.headline: Commission to recover 67.5 mln Ecus farm fraud funds.

text.p: The European Commission said on Wednesday it will claw back 67.5 million Ecus out of 209 million Ecus of unaccounted farm funds paid to member states in 1991 and 1992.
The balance was reduced after discussions in a conciliation committee and pledges from member states to put things right, a Commission spokesman said.
Together with penalties imposed in March, it brings to 855.5 million Ecus the amount of farm money recovered from the 1992 budget.
Around two-thirds of the extra penalties were imposed on Greece for misuse of cotton, tobacco and olive oil aid.
Italy and Spain were also penalised for misuse of olive oil funds while Germany and Italy were fined for wrongly using beef and livestock aid.
